provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: colors(190,:) (L44) assumes the copper colormap has at least 190 rows (default 256); fails under smaller colormap settings.
audit_member_text: Range/version risk at L43-L44: copper is called without an explicit row count and row 190 is then indexed. Environments returning the legacy 64-row default colormap raise an out-of-range error; the intended 190th color should request a sufficiently large table explicitly.

base_member_text: The quiver at L30-L32 indexes the vectors x,y with 2D subscripts and mixes strides (x uses skx twice, u/v use (1:sky:end,1:skx:end)); it works only because skx==sky==5 — changing one stride breaks the coordinate/data alignment.
audit_member_text: Potential quiver interface mismatch across L5-L6 and L30-L32: x and y are row vectors (subsampled to lengths 50 and 100), while u/v slices are 100x50 matrices. Unlike the already available xx/yy grids from L9, these coordinate arguments are not shaped to match U/V; correctness depends on whether the MATLAB version expands vector coordinates for quiver.

base_member_text: Coordinates x=2:2:500, y=2:2:1000 (L5-L6) start at 2 rather than 0; whether this matches the model's cell-center convention for the 250x500 grid is not verifiable from this file.
The mask is taken from time 00000 while the mean fields are output 00001 (L11-L13); a moving shoreline between the two would misclassify cells.
file_no is overwritten from number to string (L7, L10), a minor type reuse.

audit_member_text: All u/v/mask/depth arrays are assumed to match the hard-coded 500x250 coordinate grid at L5-L16, with no dimension check before masking or plotting.
Dry points at L41-L45 are defined by every NaN in u after L15, so pre-existing numerical NaNs are indistinguishable from mask-derived dry cells and are plotted as sand.
MATLAB pcolor at L18 ordinarily omits the final depth row and column as colored faces.
The figures directory used at L48 is not created or checked before saveas.
